name: google-bigquery
label: Google BigQuery
description: Query, analyze, and stream data into Google BigQuery — the fully managed, serverless data warehouse

run_query.label: Run a Query
run_query.description: Execute a SQL query on BigQuery and return the results as flat rows

query.label: SQL Query
query.description: The SQL query to run. Uses standard SQL syntax. Example: `SELECT * FROM \`my_dataset.my_table\` LIMIT 100`

max_results.label: Max Rows
max_results.description: Maximum number of rows to return (up to 10,000)

location.label: Location
location.description: Geographic location of your dataset (e.g. US, EU, us-central1). Leave blank for US.

use_legacy_sql.label: Use Legacy SQL
use_legacy_sql.description: Enable only if your query uses BigQuery Legacy SQL syntax (not recommended)

delete_rows.label: Delete Rows
delete_rows.description: Deletes one or more rows from a BigQuery table using a SQL WHERE condition.

where_clause.label: WHERE Clause
where_clause.description: SQL condition to match the rows to delete. Do not include the WHERE keyword. Example: `status = "inactive" AND created_at < "2023-01-01"`

location.label: Location
location.description: Dataset location (e.g. US, EU). Leave blank to use the default.

update_rows.label: Update Row(s)
update_rows.description: Updates one or more existing rows in a BigQuery table using SQL SET and WHERE expressions.

set_expression.label: SET Expression
set_expression.description: Comma-separated column assignments. Do not include the SET keyword. Example: `status = "active", updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()`

where_clause.label: WHERE Clause
where_clause.description: SQL condition to match the rows to update. Do not include the WHERE keyword. Example: `id = "abc123"`

location.label: Location
location.description: Dataset location (e.g. US, EU). Leave blank to use the default.

find_one_row.label: Find One Row
find_one_row.description: Find a single row by specifying a WHERE clause and an optional ORDER BY. Returns the first matching row, or empty if none found.

where_clause.label: WHERE Clause
where_clause.description: SQL condition to filter rows. Do not include the WHERE keyword. Example: `email = "user@example.com"`

order_by.label: ORDER BY
order_by.description: Optional column(s) to sort results before picking the first row. Example: `created_at DESC`

location.label: Location
location.description: Dataset location (e.g. US, EU). Leave blank to use the default.

body.query: SELECT * FROM `{{project_id}}.sample001z.sample002z` WHERE {{where_clause}} ORDER BY {{order_by}} LIMIT 1

get_rows_for_job.label: Get Rows for Job Completed
get_rows_for_job.description: Retrieves the result rows from a completed BigQuery query job by Job ID. Use this after a "Query Job Completed" trigger to fetch the full result set.

job_id.label: Job ID
job_id.description: The BigQuery job ID to fetch results for. This is returned by the "Query Job Completed" trigger or a "Run a Query" action.

max_results.label: Max Rows
max_results.description: Maximum number of rows to return (up to 10,000). Default: 1,000.

location.label: Location
location.description: Dataset location where the job ran (e.g. US, EU). Leave blank for US.
